title: The Campus Library Orientation: A Process and Review
instructions: 阅读以下关于大学图书馆新生导览的模拟材料（非真实考试内容）。文章共约650词，包含流程说明和学术阶段复测。请仔细阅读后完成10道题目。题目类型包括单选题、填空题（答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制）和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。所有解释均为中文，并附原文证据。
passage:
The Campus Library Orientation: A Process and Review

[A] Welcome to the campus library. This orientation is designed to help new students understand how the library works and how to use its resources effectively. The process is simple, but it is important to follow each step carefully. First, you need to register at the front desk. A student card is required, and it must be shown to the librarian. After registration, you will receive a library guide and a map. The guide, which is updated every year, explains the rules and services. Then, you should attend a short training session. These sessions are held every hour and last about twenty minutes. During the session, you will be shown how to search for books using the online catalogue. The catalogue can be accessed from any computer in the library. Finally, you are allowed to borrow books. Undergraduate students can borrow up to ten books at a time, while postgraduate students can borrow up to fifteen. Books must be returned within two weeks, but they can be renewed online if no one else has requested them. If a book is returned late, a small fine is charged. The fine is ten cents per day for each book. You can pay the fine at the front desk or online. Remember to check the due date, which is printed on a slip inside each book. This slip also shows the book's shelf number, helping you find it again easily.

[B] The library also offers quiet study areas and group discussion rooms. Group rooms must be booked in advance, and they can be reserved for a maximum of two hours. The booking system, which is available on the library website, is easy to use. You simply select a time and a room, and then confirm your booking. If you need help, ask a librarian. They are always happy to assist. In addition, the library provides free Wi-Fi. The password is given during the training session. Printing and copying services are also available, but they are not free. You need to add credit to your student card before using these services. The cost is five cents per page for black and white printing and ten cents for colour printing. A printer is located on each floor, and it is connected to the library network. To print, you first send your document from a library computer, then go to the printer and swipe your card. If the printer is not working, report it to the information desk. The staff will fix it as soon as possible. Study areas are equipped with desks, lamps, and power sockets. Please keep them clean and tidy for other users.

[C] At the end of your first month, you will take a short review test. This test is designed to check your understanding of the library system. It is not a formal exam, but it helps the library staff know if you need more help. The test covers the borrowing rules, the booking system, and the location of different sections. You will be asked to complete a few tasks, such as finding a book on the shelf and booking a group room. The test is marked by a librarian, and the results are used to improve the orientation programme. If you do not pass the first time, you can take it again after one week. Most students pass easily, but some need extra practice. The library staff are friendly and patient, so don't worry if you find something difficult. A feedback form, which is given after the test, allows you to share your thoughts. Your comments are read carefully by the library team. They use this information to make the library better for everyone.

[D] Remember, the library is a place for learning and research. Please respect other users by keeping noise to a minimum. Food and drink are not allowed in the study areas, but you can use the café on the ground floor. Mobile phones should be set to silent mode. If you have any questions, please ask at the information desk. We hope you enjoy using the library and find it a useful resource during your studies. The library is open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. on weekdays and from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. at weekends. During exam periods, the opening hours are extended. Check the library website for updates. We look forward to seeing you here!

grammar.title: 被动语态、顺序连接词、定语从句与分词短语
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be+过去分词。顺序连接词如first, then, finally帮助组织步骤。定语从句用who/which/that等引导，修饰名词。分词短语用现在分词或过去分词短语提供额外信息，相当于定语或状语。
grammar.example: The guide, which is updated every year, explains the rules and services.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The books ______ by the librarian every day.
questions.explanation: 被动语态结构为be+过去分词，主语books是复数，所以用are checked。

questions.prompt: Which word best completes the sequence? First, register at the front desk. ______, attend a training session.
questions.explanation: 顺序连接词then表示下一步。

questions.prompt: Identify the relative clause in: The librarian who helped me was very kind.
questions.explanation: 定语从句who helped me修饰the librarian。

questions.prompt: What does the participle phrase modify in: Walking into the library, she saw the notice.
questions.explanation: 分词短语Walking into the library的逻辑主语是she，表示当她走进图书馆时。
